items.rationale: The existing capabilityBusinessStatus precedence remains implemented, but the pinned State model, Error contract and Setup flow omit required AFTER_PUBLICATION setup and GOVERNED_PUBLICATIONS. sourceFindings: capabilityBusinessStatus guards can return NEEDS_ATTENTION before otherwise ready/retired readiness; READY also requires confirmed publication.state ONLINE and no UPDATE_AVAILABLE.
capabilityRepairProjection distinguishes read-only REFRESH_READINESS, unavailable owner handoffs and explicitly confirmed Media repair. Axis cannot infer mutation authority from action metadata.

invoke lines 3104-3338 gates required AFTER_PUBLICATION work on CMS READY/ONLINE, exact Media qualification and non-invalid release. GOVERNED_PUBLICATIONS must be CURRENT before deferred DATA_RELEASE execution.

sourceFindings: JavaScript mergeModels validates keyed plain maps, overlays by export key and mergeModel replaces array values; import header identity/deletion remains separate.

JSON processes streamed root arrays. CSV passes csvTypeParserOptions and encoding. ExcelJS loads a workbook, chooses the configured 1-based sheet or first sheet, trims headers and preserves formula/result objects rather than evaluating formulas.

DataExportService carries original actor/scope through owner reads and renders CSV/JSON; absence of DefaultSchemaReadAccessPolicyService returns cloned unmasked records, so mandatory masking is not guaranteed.

CSV values beginning =,+,-,@ are neutralized, but leading whitespace/tab/CR is not covered by that path. Standalone XLSX safeValue also handles tab/CR, but is not wired into generated export selection.
The new dataReleases contribution limits are not an 8 MiB parser admission limit or 1 MiB Excel/JSON/CSV record limit. No such limit is claimed by the provider article.
correctnessAndCoverageLimitations: EXPORT_POLICY_INTEGRATION_GAP: required masking cannot be claimed when the optional access-policy service is absent.
UNSUPPORTED_GENERATED_EXPORT_PROVIDER: standalone Excel rendering/package presence is not generated XLSX dispatch support.
CSV formula defenses are limited; qualify the real consuming spreadsheet and leading-whitespace/control-character cases. No live parser/export/Media acceptance was executed.

items.rationale: Pricing changes retain createGoverned authority and add strict Store-scoped delivery roots without contradicting the guide. sourceFindings: Inventory rejects stock mutation in COMMERCE_STAGED/STAGED and direct operational snapshots for balance/movement/reservation in OPERATIONAL_VERSIONED mode.
balanceAction replay identity does not make sequential balance/movement writes a proven cross-worker transaction.
